description.short: Two Zone irrigation controller with one solenoid valve. Perfect for residential gardens, lawns, rooftop gardens, and light commercial applications.
description.long: The NBGATV3.2 is Nelbac's entry-level automation controller designed specifically for residential and light commercial irrigation needs. With two independently controllable zones, it provides smart scheduling, power failure recovery, and flexible manual operation — all in a compact, weather-resistant enclosure.

images.alt: NBGATV3.2 Two Zone Controller - Front View

summary: Memory saves program during power outages

detailed.title: Smart Zone Management
detailed.subtitle: Intelligent control for every corner.
detailed.description: Manage two independent irrigation zones with customized schedules and durations. Set different watering times for each zone based on plant type, soil conditions, and sunlight exposure. The controller automatically sequences between zones for optimal water distribution.

detailed.title: Power Failure Recovery
detailed.subtitle: Never miss a watering cycle.
detailed.description: Our proprietary EEPROM-based memory system ensures your irrigation schedules persist through power outages. When power returns, the controller automatically resumes operations exactly where it left off — no reprogramming needed, no missed cycles, no wasted water.

detailed.title: Flexible Installation
detailed.subtitle: Built for Indian conditions.
detailed.description: Designed with an IP65-rated enclosure for indoor and outdoor mounting. Compatible with standard AC solenoid valves and DC latch valves. Supports direct water pump control with built-in relay protection. Installation takes under 30 minutes with our quick-connect terminal system.

seo.metaDescription: Two Zone irrigation controller with EEPROM memory, power failure recovery, and flexible installation. Perfect for residential gardens and light commercial applications.

description.short: Four Zone irrigation controller with one solenoid valve. Different duration can be set for each zone based on plant type, emitters, water pressure, and flow rate.
description.long: The NBGATV3.4 is Nelbac's mid-range automation controller built for users who need granular control over multiple irrigation zones. With four independently configurable zones, per-zone duration settings, and hydroponics-ready precision, it bridges the gap between residential simplicity and commercial capability.

images.alt: NBGATV3.4 Four Zone Controller - Front View

summary: Memory saves program during power outages

detailed.title: Per-Zone Duration Control
detailed.subtitle: Precision for every plant type.
detailed.description: Set individual watering durations for each of the four zones based on your specific plant requirements, emitter types, water pressure, and flow rate. From delicate flowers to hardy shrubs — every zone gets exactly what it needs, nothing more, nothing less.

detailed.title: Hydroponics Ready
detailed.subtitle: Engineered for soilless growing.
detailed.description: Purpose-built timing precision makes the NBGATV3.4 ideal for hydroponic and aquaponic setups. Control nutrient delivery, drainage cycles, and flood-and-drain sequences with second-level accuracy. The four independent zones let you manage different growth stages simultaneously.

detailed.title: Robust Memory System
detailed.subtitle: Set once. Run forever.
detailed.description: Advanced non-volatile EEPROM storage retains all programming through unlimited power cycles. Your schedules, zone configurations, and custom settings survive everything — from planned maintenance shutdowns to unexpected outages. The system resumes autonomously without any user intervention.

seo.metaDescription: Four Zone irrigation controller with per-zone duration control, hydroponics support, and robust EEPROM memory. Ideal for residential, hydroponics, and aquaponics.

description.short: Six Zone irrigation controller with one solenoid valve. Different duration can be set for each zone based on plant type, emitters, water pressure, and flow rate. Ideal for small/marginal farms.
description.long: The NBGATV3.6 is Nelbac's flagship automation controller designed for farm-scale operations. Featuring six independently configurable zones, an ESP32 dual-core processor with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, IP67 weather resistance, and OTA firmware updates — it delivers industrial reliability with future-ready IoT connectivity.

images.alt: NBGATV3.6 Six Zone Controller - Front View

summary: Memory saves program during power outages

detailed.title: Farm-Scale Automation
detailed.subtitle: From smallholdings to commercial plots.
detailed.description: Six independently configurable zones cover up to 2 acres of mixed cultivation. Assign different crop types to different zones with unique watering schedules, durations, and frequencies. The sequential zone activation prevents pressure drops and ensures consistent coverage across your entire operation.

detailed.title: Industrial Reliability
detailed.subtitle: Built to outlast harsh conditions.
detailed.description: Military-grade IP67 enclosure withstands dust storms, heavy rainfall, and temperature extremes from -10°C to 55°C. Surge-protected inputs handle voltage spikes common in rural power grids. Stainless steel terminal blocks resist corrosion in high-humidity environments.

detailed.title: Future-Ready Connectivity
detailed.subtitle: IoT integration at its core.
detailed.description: Powered by the ESP32 dual-core processor with built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth capabilities. Access real-time zone status, modify schedules remotely, and receive alerts for anomalies. OTA firmware updates ensure your controller evolves with new features — without a single farm visit.
